name: FUSEA x Alex's Lemonade Stand
description: Quench your thirst for entrepreneurship with FUSEA and Alex's Lemonade! Come support FUSEA as we sell lemonade to raise money for Alex's Lemonade, a charity for childhood cancer research. It is a pay-what-you-can event so you can pay $0.5 for a glass of lemonade or $20. All proceeds go to Alex's Lemonade!
